reviewer: theme_palettes; independent of original flow-guide author
scope: All 15 flow guide bodies and 45 referenced example HTML records, read in full against the 101 frozen rule scopes. Static source review and bounded local HTML constraint probes; no build, styling acceptance, assistive-technology study or live HA verification.

pages.note: Preserves playback/output/input distinctions, unsupported seek and command confirmation. Three source-complete examples use local feedback only; volume draft now uses the shared range-target class.

Current official Map source confirms grouping, accuracy circles and panel lists. Zone editing remains configuration; privacy is presentation, not authorization. Synthetic radius constraints and an explicit disclosure choice are now enforced.

Connection, entity and authentication failures remain distinct; retained readings are dated and uncertain save outcomes are inspected before retry. All three links lead to complete local recovery explanations.

Native contents and default encryption were checked against current official backup guidance. Local/remote copies, hashes and restore evidence remain distinct. Both example review statements must now be checked before local completion feedback.
Official update source confirms off can mean a skipped release. Examples retain actual version names, missing progress and a real guidance route without invented install/cancel/repair actions.
Native owner creation, restore, discovery, configuration and reauthentication remain separate. No example collects secrets or navigates to a fake sign-in endpoint; all local destinations exist.

Configuration scope, invalid identifiers and saved versus draft values are explicit. Move review cannot operate a device and does not claim native keyboard reordering. Actual editor limitations remain acceptance work.
Number formatting, date-only values and repeated-hour offsets preserve their data types. Corrected the to-do entity label to identify the containing list rather than an individual task.

Historical source/fixture/live scopes are kept separate and untested native/assistive tasks are visible. Matrix reference corrected; the example record is now a complete unexecuted plan with required evidence fields rather than an ambiguously complete result.

Typed, recognition, acknowledgement and device-result meanings remain distinct. Corrected the blanket no-listening-on-open rule to preserve explicit native start_listening shortcuts; ambiguous-target example now requires a deliberate choice.

List count, item status, due-date type, notification and deletion remain separate. Local add feedback explicitly saves nothing; the failed-sync specimen preserves the original item and avoids duplicate recovery.

Observations, forecasts, source scope, issue/valid times and warning severity remain distinct. Successful empty and failed warning responses have different complete examples with no all-clear or safety claim.

Acceptance, delivery/read evidence, dismissal and condition resolution remain separate. Shared previews contain no sensitive data and state their authorization boundary. Native badge presentation is not described as delivery logic.

Selection scope, hidden selected rows and per-member outcomes are explicit. The static empty-filter specimen does not advertise a nonfunctional reset control. Stable IDs, authorization and native persistence remain authoritative.

Exact hosts, public tokens, maintained components and reference examples are separated. Historical checks and current source review are not new live passes; cleanup and unsupported fallback retain current native data.

evidence_before.excerpt: | Ready / listening | Name the listening state and the actual stop control. | Do not start recording because a panel opened. |

findings.finding: The blanket opening/listening prohibition would also forbid an explicitly configured native Assist shortcut.
findings.change: Limit the prohibition to ordinary navigation/theme changes; preserve clearly labelled native start_listening actions.
findings.acceptance: Source text distinguishes incidental navigation from deliberate voice activation; native shortcut behaviour remains to be tested in its actual environment.
findings.verification: Source review; local source-HTML constraints where applicable. Integrated styling/browser suite remains with root.

findings.change: Label it List entity identifier and retain the exact sample literal.
findings.acceptance: The specimen and official to-do list model agree; individual item identity is not conflated with the list entity.
findings.verification: Source review; local source-HTML constraints where applicable. Integrated styling/browser suite remains with root.

findings.change: Declare an example-only 1–500 metre whole-number range and validate it without claiming those are native universal limits.
findings.acceptance: Local HTML validity rejects -1 and accepts 40; the hint states the synthetic scope and native bounds remain authoritative.
